hero.title: THE GAUNTLET
hero.body: Seven 200m runs. Seven workout stations. Alternate between explosive sprints and demanding functional exercises — this is MARATHAX.

overview.title: RUN. WORK. REPEAT.
overview.body: Athletes alternate between a 200m run and a functional workout station. Complete all reps at each station before moving to the next run. Your total time is your score.

runSections.title: 6 × 200M RUNS
runSections.body: Every station is preceded by a 200m run. Seven runs total across the full course.

stations.title: 7 FUNCTIONAL STATIONS
stations.body: Each station tests a different physical quality. Reps and weights are scaled by category. All reps must be completed before proceeding to the next run.

items.label: Dumbbell Step-Ups
items.detail: Weighted step-ups onto a box targeting quads, glutes and single-leg stability. Men: 2×10 kg · Women: 2×5 kg · Kids (Rising Star): 2×2 kg, 10 reps.

items.label: Farmer Carry
items.detail: Heavy loaded carry for grip strength, core bracing and total-body endurance. Men: 2×20 kg, 100m · Women: 2×15 kg, 100m · Kids: 2×2 kg, 50m.

items.label: Sandbag Lunges
items.detail: Walking lunges with a sandbag — legs, core and balance under load. Men: 20 kg, 100m · Women: 10 kg, 100m. Kids (Rising Star): replaced by Cognitive Cross Cone Challenge — 50m agility pattern.

items.label: Net Crawl
items.detail: Low crawl under a military-style net — full-body coordination, shoulder endurance and mental grit. 25 metres for all categories.

items.label: Tyre Flip
items.detail: Explosive posterior chain power — drive through the hips to flip a heavy tyre. 20 reps for all categories (tyre weight scaled per category).

items.label: Burpees
items.detail: Full-body explosive movement. Men, Women & Doubles: 30 reps. Kids (Rising Star): 10 reps.

items.label: Basketball Shot
items.detail: Final station — sink 1 basketball shot to complete the race. Must score before the clock stops. Applies to all categories.

items.rule: All reps at each station must be completed before moving to the next run section.
Judges are stationed at every workout station to validate reps. No-reps must be redone.
Athletes must stay within their designated lane during running sections.
Equipment must be returned to the starting position after each station.
Assistance from other athletes is not permitted in individual categories.
In Doubles, both athletes must complete all reps together or split them as they choose.
Any form of performance-enhancing substance is strictly prohibited.
The decision of judges is final. Disputes must be raised before the next station begins.
Basketball Shot (Station 7): the athlete must score 1 basket before the clock stops. No limit on attempts — time continues until the shot is made.

individual.title: INDIVIDUAL
individual.body: Compete alone. Your time is your score. Ranked against all athletes in your category.

doubles.title: DOUBLES
doubles.body: Compete as a pair. Both athletes run together and split or share reps at each station. Combined finish time is your score.
